source: Revvity open-source ChemDraw file format code, chemdraw/CDXConstants.h (BSD-3-Clause)

0x0001.name: CreationUserName
0x0001.description: The name of the creator (program user's name) of the document. (CDXString)

0x0003.name: CreationProgram
0x0003.description: The name of the program, including version and platform, that created the associated CDX object. ChemDraw 4.0 uses ChemDraw 4.0 as the value of CreationProgram. (CDXString)

0x0004.name: ModificationUserName
0x0004.description: The name of the last modifier (program user's name) of the document. (CDXString)

0x0006.name: ModificationProgram
0x0006.description: The name of the program, including version and platform, of the last program to perform a modification. ChemDraw 4.0 uses ChemDraw 4.0 as the value of CreationProgram. (CDXString)

0x0009.name: Comment
0x0009.description: An arbitrary string intended to be meaningful to a user. (CDXString)

0x000b.name: RegistryNumber
0x000b.description: A registry or catalog number of a molecule object. (CDXString)

0x000c.name: RegistryAuthority
0x000c.description: A string that specifies the authority which issued a registry or catalog number. Some examples of registry authorities are CAS, Beilstein, Aldrich, and Merck. (CDXString)

0x000d.name: Unused2
0x000d.description: Indicates that this object (the reference object) is an alias to an object elsewhere in the document (the target object). The attributes and contained objects should be taken from the target object. (

0x000e.name: RepresentsProperty
0x000e.description: Indicates that this object represents some property in some other object. (CDXRepresentsProperty)

0x000f.name: IgnoreWarnings
0x000f.description: Signifies whether chemical warnings should be suppressed on this object. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0010.name: ChemicalWarning
0x0010.description: A warning concerning possible chemical problems with this object. (CDXString)

0x0011.name: Visible
0x0011.description: The object is visible if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x0012.name: Transparent
0x0012.description: The object is transparent if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x0013.name: SupersededBy
0x0013.description: The ID of the object that should be read instead of this one. (CDXObjectID)

0x0014.name: StructurePerspective
0x0014.description: The object shows perspective if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x0100.name: FontTable
0x0100.description: A list of fonts used in the document. (CDXFontTable)

0x0200.name: 2DPosition
0x0200.description: The 2D location (in the order of vertical and horizontal locations) of an object. (CDXPoint2D)

0x0201.name: 3DPosition
0x0201.description: The 3D location (in the order of X-, Y-, and Z-locations in right-handed coordinate system) of an object in CDX coordinate units. The precise meaning of this attribute varies depending on the type of

0x0202.name: 2DExtent
0x0202.description: The width and height of an object in CDX coordinate units. The precise meaning of this attribute varies depending on the type of object. (CDXPoint2D)

0x0203.name: 3DExtent
0x0203.description: The width, height, and depth of an object in CDX coordinate units (right-handed coordinate system). The precise meaning of this attribute varies depending on the type of object. (CDXPoint3D)

0x0204.name: BoundingBox
0x0204.description: The smallest rectangle that encloses the graphical representation of the object. (CDXRectangle)

0x0205.name: RotationAngle
0x0205.description: The angular orientation of an object in degrees * 65536. (INT32)

0x0206.name: BoundsInParent
0x0206.description: The bounds of this object in the coordinate system of its parent (used for pages within tables). (CDXRectangle)

0x0207.name: 3DHead
0x0207.description: The 3D location (in the order of X-, Y-, and Z-locations in right-handed coordinate system) of the head of an object in CDX coordinate units. The precise meaning of this attribute varies depending on

0x0208.name: 3DTail
0x0208.description: The 3D location (in the order of X-, Y-, and Z-locations in right-handed coordinate system) of the tail of an object in CDX coordinate units. The precise meaning of this attribute varies depending on

0x0209.name: TopLeft
0x0209.description: The location of the top-left corner of a quadrilateral object, possibly in a rotated or skewed frame. (CDXPoint2D)

0x020a.name: TopRight
0x020a.description: The location of the top-right corner of a quadrilateral object, possibly in a rotated or skewed frame. (CDXPoint2D)

0x020b.name: BottomRight
0x020b.description: The location of the bottom-right corner of a quadrilateral object, possibly in a rotated or skewed frame. (CDXPoint2D)

0x020c.name: BottomLeft
0x020c.description: The location of the bottom-left corner of a quadrilateral object, possibly in a rotated or skewed frame. (CDXPoint2D)

0x020d.name: 3DCenter
0x020d.description: The 3D location (in the order of X-, Y-, and Z-locations in right-handed coordinate system) of the logical center of an object in CDX coordinate units. The precise meaning of this attribute varies dep

0x020e.name: 3DMajorAxisEnd
0x020e.description: The 3D location (in the order of X-, Y-, and Z-locations in right-handed coordinate system) of the end of the major axis of an object in CDX coordinate units. The precise meaning of this attribute var

0x020f.name: 3DMinorAxisEnd
0x020f.description: The 3D location (in the order of X-, Y-, and Z-locations in right-handed coordinate system) of the end of the minor axis of an object in CDX coordinate units. The precise meaning of this attribute var

0x0300.name: ColorTable
0x0300.description: The color palette used throughout the document. (CDXColorTable)

0x0301.name: ForegroundColor
0x0301.description: The foreground color of an object represented as the two-based index into the object's color table. (UINT16)

0x0302.name: BackgroundColor
0x0302.description: The background color of an object represented as the two-based index into the object's color table. (UINT16)

0x0303.name: FadePercent
0x0303.description: The percent by which to fade the fill color of the graphic (allowing for four significant figures so 1000 is 100.0%). (INT16)

0x0306.name: ForegroundAlpha
0x0306.description: The alpha value of the foreground color. (UINT16)

0x0307.name: BackgroundAlpha
0x0307.description: The alpha value of the background color. (UINT16)

0x0308.name: HighlightColor
0x0308.description: The highlight color for an object

0x0400.name: Node_Type
0x0400.description: The type of a node object. (INT16)

0x0401.name: Node_LabelDisplay
0x0401.description: The characteristics of node label display. (INT8)

0x0402.name: Node_Element
0x0402.description: The atomic number of the atom representing this node. (INT16)

0x0404.name: Atom_Formula
0x0404.description: The composition of a node representing a fragment whose composition is known, but whose connectivity is not. For example, C<sub>4</sub>H<sub>9</sub> represents a mixture of the 4 butyl isomers. (CDXFo

0x0420.name: Atom_Isotope
0x0420.description: The absolute isotopic mass of an atom (2 for deuterium, 14 for carbon-14). (INT16)

0x0421.name: Atom_Charge
0x0421.description: The atomic charge of an atom. (INT8)

0x0422.name: Atom_Radical
0x0422.description: The atomic radical attribute of an atom. (UINT8)

0x0423.name: Atom_RestrictFreeSites
0x0423.description: Indicates that up to the specified number of additional substituents are permitted on this atom. (UINT8)

0x0424.name: Atom_RestrictImplicitHydrogens
0x0424.description: Signifies that implicit hydrogens are not allowed on this atom. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0425.name: Atom_RestrictRingBondCount
0x0425.description: The number of ring bonds attached to an atom. (INT8)

0x0426.name: Atom_RestrictUnsaturatedBonds
0x0426.description: Indicates whether unsaturation should be present or absent. (INT8)

0x0427.name: Atom_RestrictRxnChange
0x0427.description: If present, signifies that the reaction change of an atom must be as specified. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0428.name: Atom_RestrictRxnStereo
0x0428.description: The change of stereochemistry of an atom during a reaction. (INT8)

0x0429.name: Atom_AbnormalValence
0x0429.description: Signifies that an abnormal valence for an atom is permitted. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x042b.name: Atom_NumHydrogens
0x042b.description: The number of (explicit) hydrogens in a labeled atom consisting of one heavy atom and (optionally) the symbol H (e.g., CH<sub>3</sub>). (UINT16)

0x042e.name: Atom_HDot
0x042e.description: Signifies the presence of an implicit hydrogen with stereochemistry specified equivalent to an explicit H atom with a wedged bond. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x042f.name: Atom_HDash
0x042f.description: Signifies the presence of an implicit hydrogen with stereochemistry specified equivalent to an explicit H atom with a hashed bond. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0430.name: Atom_Geometry
0x0430.description: The geometry of the bonds about this atom. (INT8)

0x0431.name: Atom_BondOrdering
0x0431.description: An ordering of the bonds to this node, used for stereocenters, fragments, and named alternative groups with more than one attachment. (CDXObjectIDArray)

0x0432.name: Node_Attachments
0x0432.description: For multicenter attachment nodes or variable attachment nodes, a list of IDs of the nodes which are multiply or variably attached to this node. (CDXObjectIDArrayWithCounts)

0x0433.name: Atom_GenericNickname
0x0433.description: The name of the generic nickname. (CDXString)

0x0434.name: Atom_AltGroupID
0x0434.description: The ID of the alternative group object that describes this node. (CDXObjectID)

0x0435.name: Atom_RestrictSubstituentsUpTo
0x0435.description: Indicates that substitution is restricted to no more than the specified value. (UINT8)

0x0436.name: Atom_RestrictSubstituentsExactly
0x0436.description: Indicates that exactly the specified number of substituents must be present. (UINT8)

0x0437.name: Atom_CIPStereochemistry
0x0437.description: The node's absolute stereochemistry according to the Cahn-Ingold-Prelog system. (INT8)

0x0438.name: Atom_Translation
0x0438.description: Provides for restrictions on whether a given node may match other more- or less-general nodes. (INT8)

0x043a.name: Atom_ShowQuery
0x043a.description: Show the query indicator if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x043b.name: Atom_ShowStereo
0x043b.description: Show the stereochemistry indicator if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x043c.name: Atom_ShowAtomNumber
0x043c.description: Show the atom number if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x043d.name: Atom_LinkCountLow
0x043d.description: Low end of repeat count for link nodes. (INT16)

0x043e.name: Atom_LinkCountHigh
0x043e.description: High end of repeat count for link nodes. (INT16)

0x043f.name: Atom_IsotopicAbundance
0x043f.description: Isotopic abundance of this atom's isotope. (INT8)

0x0440.name: Atom_ExternalConnectionType
0x0440.description: Type of external connection, for atoms of type kCDXNodeType_ExternalConnectionPoint. (INT8)

0x0442.name: Atom_ShowTerminalCarbonLabels
0x0442.description: Signifies whether terminal carbons (carbons with zero or one bond) should display a text label with the element symbol and appropriate hydrogens. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0443.name: Atom_ShowNonTerminalCarbonLabels
0x0443.description: Signifies whether non-terminal carbons (carbons with more than one bond) should display a text label with the element symbol and appropriate hydrogens. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0444.name: Atom_HideImplicitHydrogens
0x0444.description: Signifies whether implicit hydrogens should be displayed on otherwise-atomic atom labels (NH2 versus N). (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0445.name: Atom_ShowEnhancedStereo
0x0445.description: Show the enhanced stereochemistry indicator if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x0446.name: Atom_EnhancedStereoType
0x0446.description: The type of enhanced stereochemistry present on this atom. (INT8)

0x0447.name: Atom_EnhancedStereoGroupNum
0x0447.description: The group number associated with Or and And enhanced stereochemistry types. (INT16)

0x0448.name: Node_NeedsClean
0x0448.description: Does the node need to be cleaned (CDXBoolean)

0x044a.name: Atom_ShowResidueID
0x044a.description: Show the residue ID if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x044b.name: Atom_ExternalConnectionNum
0x044b.description: Num of external connection, for atoms of type kCDXNodeType_ExternalConnectionPoint. (INT8)

0x044e.name: Node_HydrogenBondAttachmentAtoms
0x044e.description: The atoms in a monomer which connect to external hydrogen bonds. (CDXObjectIDArray)

0x044f.name: Node_HydrogenBonds
0x044f.description: The external hydrogen bonds of this node. (CDXObjectIDArray)

0x0500.name: Mole_Racemic
0x0500.description: Indicates that the molecule is a racemic mixture. (CDXBoolean)

0x0501.name: Mole_Absolute
0x0501.description: Indicates that the molecule has known absolute configuration. (CDXBoolean)

0x0502.name: Mole_Relative
0x0502.description: Indicates that the molecule has known relative stereochemistry, but unknown absolute configuration. (CDXBoolean)

0x0503.name: Mole_Formula
0x0503.description: The molecular formula representation of a molecule object. (CDXFormula)

0x0504.name: Mole_Weight
0x0504.description: The average molecular weight of a molecule object. (FLOAT64)

0x0505.name: Frag_ConnectionOrder
0x0505.description: An ordered list of attachment points within a fragment. (CDXObjectIDArray)

0x0506.name: Frag_SequenceType
0x0506.description: The sequence type of the fragment, for fragments that represent sequences (peptides and nucleotides, primarily). (INT8)

0x0507.name: Frag_IsFromGuidedStereo
0x0507.description: Is this fragment from Guided Stereo (CDXBoolean)

0x0508.name: Frag_IsComplement
0x0508.description: Is this fragment a complementary RNA/DNA sequence fragment. (CDXBoolean)

0x0600.name: Bond_Order
0x0600.description: The order of a bond object. (INT16)

0x0601.name: Bond_Display
0x0601.description: The display type of a bond object. (INT16)

0x0602.name: Bond_Display2
0x0602.description: The display type for the second line of a double bond. (INT16)

0x0603.name: Bond_DoublePosition
0x0603.description: The position of the second line of a double bond. (INT16)

0x0604.name: Bond_Begin
0x0604.description: The ID of the CDX node object at the first end of a bond. (CDXObjectID)

0x0605.name: Bond_End
0x0605.description: The ID of the CDX node object at the second end of a bond. (CDXObjectID)

0x0606.name: Bond_RestrictTopology
0x0606.description: Indicates the desired topology of a bond in a query. (INT8)

0x0607.name: Bond_RestrictRxnParticipation
0x0607.description: Specifies that a bond is affected by a reaction. (INT8)

0x0608.name: Bond_BeginAttach
0x0608.description: Indicates where within the Bond_Begin node a bond is attached. (UINT8)

0x0609.name: Bond_EndAttach
0x0609.description: Indicates where within the Bond_End node a bond is attached. (UINT8)

0x060a.name: Bond_CIPStereochemistry
0x060a.description: The bond's absolute stereochemistry according to the Cahn-Ingold-Prelog system. (INT8)

0x060b.name: Bond_BondOrdering
0x060b.description: Ordered list of attached bond IDs. (CDXObjectIDArray)

0x060c.name: Bond_ShowQuery
0x060c.description: Show the query indicator if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x060d.name: Bond_ShowStereo
0x060d.description: Show the stereochemistry indicator if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x060e.name: Bond_CrossingBonds
0x060e.description: Unordered list of IDs of bonds that cross this one (either above or below). (CDXObjectIDArray)

0x060f.name: Bond_ShowRxn
0x060f.description: Show the reaction-change indicator if non-zero. (CDXBoolean)

0x0611.name: Bond_BeginExternalNum
0x0611.description: The external connection number at the first end of a bond. (INT8)

0x0612.name: Bond_EndExternalNum
0x0612.description: The external connection number at the second end of a bond. (INT8)

0x0613.name: Bond_Connectivity_Routed
0x0613.description: Specify whether the bond is routed (CDXBoolean)

0x0700.name: Text
0x0700.description: The text of a text object. (CDXString)

0x0701.name: Justification
0x0701.description: The horizontal justification of a text object. (INT8)

0x0702.name: LineHeight
0x0702.description: The line height of a text object. (UINT16)

0x0703.name: WordWrapWidth
0x0703.description: The word-wrap width of a text object. (INT16)

0x0704.name: LineStarts
0x0704.description: The number of lines of a text object followed by that many values indicating the zero-based text position of each line start. (INT16ListWithCounts)

0x0705.name: LabelAlignment
0x0705.description: The alignment of the text with respect to the node position. (INT8)

0x0706.name: LabelLineHeight
0x0706.description: Text line height for atom labels (INT16)

0x0707.name: CaptionLineHeight
0x0707.description: Text line height for non-atomlabel text objects (INT16)

0x0708.name: InterpretChemically
0x0708.description: Signifies whether to the text label should be interpreted chemically (if possible). (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0800.name: MacPrintInfo
0x0800.description: The 120 byte Macintosh TPrint data associated with the CDX document object. Refer to Macintosh Toolbox manual for detailed description. (Unformatted)

0x0801.name: WinPrintInfo
0x0801.description: The Windows DEVMODE structure associated with the CDX document object. (Unformatted)

0x0802.name: PrintMargins
0x0802.description: The outer margins of the Document. (CDXRectangle)

0x0803.name: ChainAngle
0x0803.description: The default chain angle setting in degrees * 65536. (INT32)

0x0804.name: BondSpacing
0x0804.description: The spacing between segments of a multiple bond, measured relative to bond length. (INT16)

0x0808.name: MarginWidth
0x0808.description: The default amount of space surrounding atom labels. (CDXCoordinate)

0x0809.name: HashSpacing
0x0809.description: The default spacing between hashed lines used in wedged hashed bonds. (CDXCoordinate)

0x080a.name: LabelStyle
0x080a.description: The default style for atom labels. (CDXFontStyle)

0x080b.name: CaptionStyle
0x080b.description: The default style for non-atomlabel text objects. (CDXFontStyle)

0x080c.name: CaptionJustification
0x080c.description: The horizontal justification of a caption (non-atomlabel text object) (INT8)

0x080d.name: FractionalWidths
0x080d.description: Signifies whether to use fractional width information when drawing text. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x080f.name: WidthPages
0x080f.description: The width of the document in pages. (INT16)

0x0810.name: HeightPages
0x0810.description: The height of the document in pages. (INT16)

0x0811.name: DrawingSpaceType
0x0811.description: The type of drawing space used for this document. (INT8)

0x0812.name: Width
0x0812.description: The width of an object in CDX coordinate units, possibly in a rotated or skewed frame. (CDXCoordinate)

0x0813.name: Height
0x0813.description: The height of an object in CDX coordinate units, possibly in a rotated or skewed frame. (CDXCoordinate)

0x0814.name: PageOverlap
0x0814.description: The amount of overlap of pages when a poster is tiled. (CDXCoordinate)

0x0816.name: HeaderPosition
0x0816.description: The vertical offset of the header baseline from the top of the page. (CDXCoordinate)

0x0818.name: FooterPosition
0x0818.description: The vertical offset of the footer baseline from the bottom of the page. (CDXCoordinate)

0x0819.name: PrintTrimMarks
0x0819.description: If present, trim marks are to printed in the margins. (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x081a.name: LabelStyleFont
0x081a.description: The default font family for atom labels. (INT16)

0x081b.name: CaptionStyleFont
0x081b.description: The default font style for captions (non-atom-label text objects). (INT16)

0x081c.name: LabelStyleSize
0x081c.description: The default font size for atom labels. (INT16)

0x081d.name: CaptionStyleSize
0x081d.description: The default font size for captions (non-atom-label text objects). (INT16)

0x081e.name: LabelStyleFace
0x081e.description: The default font style for atom labels. (INT16)

0x081f.name: CaptionStyleFace
0x081f.description: The default font face for captions (non-atom-label text objects). (INT16)

0x0820.name: LabelStyleColor
0x0820.description: The default color for atom labels (INT16)

0x0821.name: CaptionStyleColor
0x0821.description: The default color for captions (non-atom-label text objects). (INT16)

0x0822.name: BondSpacingAbs
0x0822.description: The absolute distance between segments of a multiple bond. (CDXCoordinate)

0x0823.name: LabelJustification
0x0823.description: The default justification for atom labels. (INT8)

0x0824.name: FixInplaceExtent
0x0824.description: Defines a size for OLE In-Place editing. (CDXPoint2D)

0x0825.name: Side
0x0825.description: A specific side of an object (rectangle). (INT16)

0x0826.name: FixInplaceGap
0x0826.description: Defines a padding for OLE In-Place editing. (CDXPoint2D)

0x0827.name: CartridgeData
0x0827.description: Transient data used by the CambridgeSoft Oracle Cartridge.  Should not be read or written by anyone other than the cartridge. (Unformatted)

0x0828.name: AminoAcidTermini
0x0828.description: The default display style for amino-acid termini (INT8)

0x082f.name: BondSpacingType
0x082f.description: select between using kCDXProp_BondSpacingAbs  and kCDXProp_BondSpacing ((INT8))

0x0830.name: LabelStyleFontName
0x0830.description: name of the label font - supersedes kCDXProp_LabelStyleFont

0x0831.name: CaptionStyleFontName
0x0831.description: name of the caption font - supersedes kCDXProp_CaptionStyleFont

0x0900.name: Window_IsZoomed
0x0900.description: Signifies whether the main viewing window is zoomed (maximized). (CDXBooleanImplied)

0x0901.name: Window_Position
0x0901.description: The top-left position of the main viewing window. (CDXPoint2D)

0x0902.name: Window_Size
0x0902.description: Height and width of the document window. (CDXPoint2D)

0x0a01.name: Line_Type
0x0a01.description: The type of a line object. (INT16)

0x0a02.name: Arrow_Type
0x0a02.description: The type of arrow object, which represents line, arrow, arc, rectangle, or orbital. (INT16)

0x0a03.name: Rectangle_Type
0x0a03.description: The type of a rectangle object. (INT16)

0x0a04.name: Oval_Type
0x0a04.description: The type of an arrow object that represents a circle or ellipse. (INT16)

0x0a20.name: Arrowhead_Size
0x0a20.description: The size of the arrow's head from the shaft to the outer corner (as a multiplier of line width * 100, so 12.5x the line width = 1250). (INT16)

0x0a21.name: Arc_AngularSize
0x0a21.description: The size of an arc (in degrees * 10, so 90 degrees = 900). (INT16)

0x0a23.name: Curve_Points
0x0a23.description: The Bézier curve's control point locations. (CDXCurvePoints)

0x0a24.name: Bracket_Usage
0x0a24.description: The syntactical chemical meaning of the bracket (SRU, mer, mon, xlink, etc). (INT8)

0x0a25.name: Polymer_RepeatPattern
0x0a25.description: The head-to-tail connectivity of objects contained within the bracket. (INT8)

0x0a26.name: Polymer_FlipType
0x0a26.description: The flip state of objects contained within the bracket. (INT8)

0x0a27.name: BracketedObjects
0x0a27.description: The set of objects contained in a BracketedGroup. (CDXObjectIDArray)

0x0a28.name: Bracket_RepeatCount
0x0a28.description: The number of times a multiple-group BracketedGroup is repeated. (INT16)

0x0a29.name: Bracket_ComponentOrder
0x0a29.description: The component order associated with a BracketedGroup. (INT16)

0x0a2a.name: Bracket_SRULabel
0x0a2a.description: The label associated with a BracketedGroup that represents an SRU. (CDXString)

0x0a2b.name: Bracket_GraphicID
0x0a2b.description: The ID of a graphical object (bracket, brace, or parenthesis) associated with a Bracket Attachment. (CDXObjectID)

0x0a2c.name: Bracket_BondID
0x0a2c.description: The ID of a bond that crosses a Bracket Attachment. (CDXObjectID)

0x0a2d.name: Bracket_InnerAtomID
0x0a2d.description: The ID of the node located within the Bracketed Group and attached to a bond that crosses a Bracket Attachment. (CDXObjectID)

0x0a2e.name: Curve_Points3D
0x0a2e.description: The Bézier curve's control point locations. (CDXCurvePoints3D)

0x0a30.name: Arrowhead_CenterSize
0x0a30.description: The size of the arrow's head from the tip to the back of the head (as a percentage of line width, so 12.5x the line width = 1250). (UINT16)

0x0a31.name: Arrowhead_Width
0x0a31.description: The half-width of the arrow's head (as a percentage of line width, so 12.5x the line width = 1250). (UINT16)

0x0a32.name: ShadowSize
0x0a32.description: The size of the object's shadow (as a percentage of line width, so 4x the line width = 400). (UINT16)

0x0a33.name: Arrow_ShaftSpacing
0x0a33.description: The width of the space between a multiple-component arrow shaft, as in an equilibrium arrow (as a percentage of line width, so 3x the line width = 300). (UINT16)

0x0a34.name: Arrow_EquilibriumRatio
0x0a34.description: The ratio of the length of the left component of an equilibrium arrow (viewed from the end to the start) to the right component (as a percentage, so 2x as long = 200). (UINT16)

0x0a35.name: Arrowhead_Head
0x0a35.description: The type of arrowhead at the head of the arrow or end of the curve. (INT16)

0x0a36.name: Arrowhead_Tail
0x0a36.description: The type of arrowhead at the tail of the arrow or start of the curve. (INT16)

0x0a37.name: Fill_Type
